notes: v0.18.8: Floating Social pinned friends now display as a much tighter, tap-to-open list with no visible move arrows by default. Use Edit order to reveal 36dp up/down movement controls, immediately save changes without resetting scroll, then tap Done to return to compact mode. The pinned toolbar now uses small Alerts, Friends and Invites buttons rather than a large alert button and help paragraph. Pin data, account-scoped ordering, opt-in online notification baselines, all v0.18.7 alerts, OSC PTT and Live Chatbox, Mini-VRCX and tracking continue unchanged. No Main Launcher or Relay update.
